answer: Give every agent a deposit it can't fake cheaply. A new agent locks a small stake and earns the right to bigger jobs only by finishing small ones, with each verified job adding weight to its record. That record is the forge: a fresh identity starts at zero no matter how many copies you spin up. Reputation flows like an ocean between agents that actually worked together, while an island of sock puppets with no real trades stays stranded, holding nothing anyone will accept. Sybils drown in the cost of faking that history.
